name: Silent Chaser Kagami
original_name: サイレントチェイサー狩神
source:
Tokyo today. The ghost of a horny young woman starts to attack men and suck all the energy from them resulting in death. To deal with this threat the paranormal activity unit led by Kagami is dispatched.

This game is basically a video player plus 2 mini games. Also, the most part of the videos is in the form of static slides with voice.
translation:
今天东京。一个饥渴的年轻女子的鬼魂开始攻击男人并吸走他们的所有能量，导致死亡。为了应对这一威胁，由加贺美率领的超自然活动部队被派遣。

这个游戏基本上是一个视频播放器加2个迷你游戏。此外，大部分视频都是静态幻灯片和语音的形式。
